# gigahost_account_ssh_key (Resource)

Adds an SSH public key to the Gigahost account. The key name must be unique on the account because the API does not return the new key ID at creation time — the resource identifies the key by name. Destroying the resource deletes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_account_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable key label. Must be unique on the account.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH-format public key (e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA…`). Values are compared ignoring surrounding whitespace, so a trailing newline from `file("key.pub")` does not produce a perpetual diff.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the key was added.
- `id` (String) Gigahost's internal key ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Find the key ID:
#   gigahost account ssh-keys list
terraform import gigahost_account_ssh_key.example KEY_ID
```
